## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: +4.96% | 1M: -10.33%) RECOVERY showing rising fear and SPY (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND vs TLT (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND show stocks losing to bonds, and HYG/LQD skew lower (HYG 1W: -0.22% | 1M: +0.44% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: +0.27% | 1M: +1.34% ABOVE TREND) signaling rising credit stress.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear rising: VXX (1W: +4.96% | 1M: -10.33%) RECOVERY ↑ rising. Credit stress increasing: HYG (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +0.44%) CORRECTION relative to LQD (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +1.34%) ABOVE TREND → HYG/LQD ↓. Stocks vs bonds deteriorating: SPY (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND vs TLT (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tightening: LQD (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +1.34%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND point to demand for duration while SPY/TLT is falling (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -4.99%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Defensive tilt: XLU (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) ABOVE TREND are the only sector leaders while XLK (1W: -1.70% | 1M: +1.60%) is in CORRECTION and XLF (1W: -0.97% | 1M: +3.90%) in CORRECTION — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US softening: SPY (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND while small caps outperformance persists via IWM (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.31%) ABOVE TREND. EM/activity split: EEM (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +2.61%) CORRECTION; China FXI (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -8.21%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation weakening: IBIT (1W: -8.88% | 1M: -21.16%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -2.98% | 1M: +0.42%) CORRECTION. Pockets of risk-on in biotech: XBI (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +13.82%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity weakness broad: GLD (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -11.58%) BELOW TREND and CPER (1W: -8.19% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND with metals and energy under pressure.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy broadly weak: XLE (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -9.30%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -25.93%) BELOW TREND; natural gas mixed with UNG (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +7.22%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: VXX ↑ (1W: +4.96% | 1M: -10.33%) and SPY/TLT ↓ (SPY 1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.41% BELOW TREND; TLT 1W: +1.38% | 1M: +3.59% ABOVE TREND) plus weak breadth (2/11) validate RISK-OFF. DIVERGENCE: MINOR — XLK (1W: -1.70% | 1M: +1.60%) and XLF (1W: -0.97% | 1M: +3.90%) show 1W vs 1M mismatch.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor duration and quality credit: TLT (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +1.34%) ABOVE TREND; favor defensive income/healthcare exposure via XLU (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to commodity-energy risk: XLE (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -9.30%) BELOW TREND and speculative crypto exposure like IBIT (1W: -8.88% | 1M: -21.16%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +13.82%) ABOVE TREND if momentum holds; XLU (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND for defensive inflows. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -9.30%) BELOW TREND and XLK (1W: -1.70% | 1M: +1.60%) CORRECTION on renewed risk aversion.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: UNG (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +7.22%) CORRECTION if weather/data supports. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -11.58%) BELOW TREND and broad oil ETFs like BNO (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -25.93%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~23.7 (VXX (1W: +4.96% | 1M: -10.33%) RECOVERY) as a near-term fear barometer; Credit spread / HYG-LQD ~0.73 (HYG 1W: -0.22% | 1M: +0.44% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: +0.27% | 1M: +1.34% ABOVE TREND) for funding stress; Tech vs Financials ratio XLK/XLF ~3.41 (Tech vs Financials 1W: -1.10% | 1M: -4.79%) to watch for further rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive.  
Utilities/healthcare and duration showing strength (XLU 1W: +1.64% | 1M: +0.66% ABOVE TREND; TLT 1W: +1.38% | 1M: +3.59% ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: rising fear (VXX 1W: +4.96% | 1M: -10.33% RECOVERY) and increasing credit stress (HYG/LQD skew) with a minor XLK/XLF divergence to monitor.
